title: Unnamed settlement near Meğana, Algeria
description: Remains of a quarried ancient settlement of Roman date, recorded by Gsell (AAA, whence BAtlas). Gsell places it approximately 2 kilometers southeast of the village of "Medjana". The location should lie within a kilometer of the BAtlas coordinates: a point west of the modern RN 106 highway between Meğana and Bordj Bou Arreridj in the Algerian wilaya of Bordj Bou Arreridj.

properties.description: Coordinates extracted using QGIS from a raster image of Barrington Atlas Map 31 that was georegistered to OpenStreetMap using prominent, stable landscape features. Dates after BAltDir.
